game_concept: A racing platformer set in Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs, snowy chimney rooftops: the sled courier must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against blizzard sprites.
theme: Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs: snowy chimney rooftops
core_gameplay_loop: In Chimney Roofs, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against blizzard sprites. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the sled courier ahead. Then check the spells value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the larder door by solving code steps involving spells that move the sled courier forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the larder door first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Chimney Roofs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Chimney Roofs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
